responsibilities_and_impact: Fine-tuned Deep Seek-VL-7B with LoRA for automatic scoring of IELTS Writing Task 1.
Froze vision encoder & aligner, applied LoRA to q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj of the language model.
Applied multi-GPU parallelism: visual modules on one GPU, language model split across GPUs.
Built custom data pipeline: tokenization, embedding alignment with masks, and dynamic padding via VLCollator.
Achieved MAE ~0.5 on IELTS scoring, 15-16s inference per essay, with accurate feedback across all scoring criteria.
